about: The retrieval baseline (npm run eval:retrieval): a journal built only from public GitHub metadata, as repomagpie note <url> writes it (the description as a draft What it does, up to 8 topics as tags, a guessed kind; no Verdict, no Use when), and needs written as a person would say them, each with the repositories that answer it. The first 13 repositories are those of src/core/fixtures/kinds.json, which also gives their kind guess's inputs; the rest are well-known repositories. Recorded on 2026-10-14 with gh api GET repos/<owner>/<repo> (full_name, description, topics, language, license.spdx_id, is_template). prisma/prisma now answers as prisma/orm and mendableai/firecrawl as firecrawl/firecrawl; their current names are kept.

use_when.about: Synthetic, not any user's words: one short Use when item per repository, written on 2026-10-25 for the eval's second run (feat/use-when-at-capture) plainly from the repository's description and topics, as a user might write it with repomagpie note --use-when. Written by an agent that had seen the needs below, so treat the gain as an upper bound.
